'''November 2000 Los Gatos tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Los Gatos, California on 18 November 2000. [[John Monroe]] won it. It is known from Nick Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1471">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-19-lg-sj-super-saturday-11-18-00d1471/ lg-sj-super-saturday-11-18-00], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 19 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-19-lg-sj-super-saturday-11-18-00d1471/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 18 November 2000
* '''Site:''' Los Gatos, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[John Monroe]]
